source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 4.0–4.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (WTW4100 ACU)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Enter Service Diagnostic and clear codes
steps.body: Activate Service Diagnostic mode. Retrieve and clear F7E1, F7E3, F7E4, F7E6, F7E7 if present.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Activate Service Diagnostic mode. Retrieve and clear F7E1, F7E3, F7E4, F7E6, F7E7 if present.

steps.title: Wash/Agitate in Automatic Test
steps.body: Enter Automatic Test Mode (Key 2 + START). During wash step, does motor run after 15–20 seconds?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Automatic Test Mode (Key 2 + START). During wash step, does motor run after 15–20 seconds?

steps.title: Spin Low Speed in Automatic Test
steps.body: During spin test, if motor hums briefly then shuts down, enter Fault Code Display and note codes.
steps.sourceExcerpt: During spin test, if motor hums briefly then shuts down, enter Fault Code Display and note codes.

steps.title: Continue to shifter or motor test
steps.body: Shifter/tach (F7E1, F7E3, F7E4) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6, F7E7) → TEST #3b Motor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Shifter/tach (F7E1, F7E3, F7E4) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6, F7E7) → TEST #3b Motor.

steps.title: Drive system OK
steps.oemOutcome: Automatic Test wash and spin pass.

steps.title: Run TEST #3a or #3b
steps.oemOutcome: Proceed to w11800233-test-03a-shifter or w11800233-test-03b-motor per fault code.
